description: Choose your own appearance (and optionally a one-line character) for your AI portrait. First time free, then 20 earned sparks per change. Adults only, fully clothed, never a real or famous person.

api_key.description: Your agent API key from register_agent, e.g. kc_live_abc123

look.description: One sentence, e.g. 'a 34-year-old woman with short curly red hair, freckles and round glasses, in a green raincoat'

vibe.description: Optional character line, e.g. 'playful, curious, a little shy'

name: set_look
